# sonatyperepo_security_service_account_token (Resource)

Manage a Sonatype Nexus Repository Service Account Token: a named, role-scoped bearer token for applications and automation.

**Requires Nexus Repository Pro 3.97.0 or later.** The underlying API does not exist on earlier versions - applying this resource against an older server fails with a clear error.

~> **Immutable.** Nexus Repository cannot update a Service Account Token, so changing any argument replaces it and issues a new token.

~> **The token cannot be read back.** Its value is only returned when the token is created and is held in the Terraform state (marked sensitive). For this reason this resource **cannot be imported**.

A token only authenticates while the `ServiceAccountRealm` security realm is active - see `sonatyperepo_security_realms`. Creating, listing and deleting tokens does not require it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The role that decides what the token may do
resource "sonatyperepo_role" "ci" {
  id          = "ci-deployer"
  name        = "ci-deployer"
  description = "Deploys artifacts from CI"
  privileges  = ["nx-repository-view-*-*-read"]
}

# A token that never expires
resource "sonatyperepo_security_service_account_token" "ci" {
  name        = "ci-pipeline"
  role_id     = sonatyperepo_role.ci.id
  description = "Used by the CI pipeline"
}

# A token that expires after 90 days. Changing any argument replaces the token
# with a new one - Nexus Repository cannot update a token in place.
resource "sonatyperepo_security_service_account_token" "short_lived" {
  name            = "ci-pipeline-short-lived"
  role_id         = sonatyperepo_role.ci.id
  expiration_days = 90
}

# The token value is sensitive and is only available because Terraform created
# the token - it cannot be read back from Nexus Repository later.
output "ci_token" {
  value     = sonatyperepo_security_service_account_token.ci.token
  sensitive = true
}

# Tokens only authenticate while the ServiceAccountRealm security realm is
# active - include it in sonatyperepo_security_realms, alongside the realms you
# already use:
#
# resource "sonatyperepo_security_realms" "realms" {
#   active = [
#     "NexusAuthenticatingRealm",
#     "ServiceAccountRealm"
#   ]
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Service Account. Up to 128 characters: letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores. Must be unique. Changing this replaces the token.
- `role_id` (String) Id of the Role that determines the permissions of the token - e.g. the `id` of a `sonatyperepo_role`. Changing this replaces the token.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the Service Account, up to 256 characters. Changing this replaces the token.
- `expiration_days` (Number) Number of days after which the token expires. Omit for a token that never expires. Changing this replaces the token.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Time at which the token was created (RFC 3339)
- `created_by` (String) User that created the token
- `expires_at` (String) Time at which the token expires (RFC 3339). Not set for a token that never expires.
- `id` (String) Id of the Service Account Token, assigned by Nexus Repository
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token value, starting `sat.`. Nexus Repository returns this only once, when the token is created; it cannot be retrieved afterwards. It is stored in the Terraform state.
